`advance-400.ttf` is an original synthetic font generated by
`scripts/generate-browser-font-fixtures.py`, copied here so the view crate's
standalone tests do not depend on the project tooling crate. Its A glyph has an
advance of 400 units per em. The browser and native text probes use the same bytes.
`cyrillic-400.ttf` maps four Cyrillic code points, comma and exclamation to that glyph and is generated
deterministically by `scripts/generate-view-cyrillic-font.py` for layout tests.
`advance-900.ttf` is the companion synthetic font from the same browser-fixture
generator, with a 900-unit advance and no Cyrillic glyphs.
`bold-900.ttf` and `italic-900.ttf` are synthetic alternate faces of
`Varta Fixture 400`, generated by the corresponding `scripts/generate-view-*-font.py` scripts.
